caption: The drawing depicts a full-length dress with exaggeratedly large puffed sleeves and a fitted bodice. The primary color of the dress is a light, pastel blue. The bodice has vertical striping details and a gathered or ruched center, and the neckline is high with a triangular pink collar visible underneath and pink accents inside the sleeves. The sleeves are heavily puffed at the shoulder and have pink ruffled linings. The outer fabric of the dress features a repeating floral pattern in light pink and soft blue-green on both sides of the front panel, while the center front panel is a solid light blue. The hem of the dress has a ruffled trim that incorporates both the blue and pink colors. To the upper right of the main dress illustration, there is a smaller, monochrome line drawing of the same dress, showing the overall shape and construction without color or pattern details. The background is a plain, off-white sheet of paper.
title: Reception Gown
